model.lookupLabel: MyCNHStore parts lookup (New Holland CE, ANZ)
model.note: Part outlines are traced from New Holland's studio photo of a C227 (200 Series) and are approximate. The engine, filters, hydraulic tank, cooling pack, battery, drive motors and cab controls are hidden and listed. Part numbers come from CNH filter kit 73341672, NH dealer parts diagrams and the CNH 200 Series service manual 48068128 (the OM link is that service manual; the operator's manual was not online). Confirm the main fuel filter and separator element against PIN NJM448024 before ordering.

rear.name: Rear tower, side panel and engine bay
rear.desc: Yellow rear upright and side panel over the engine bay; the loader arms pivot at the top of the tower. Daily: clean the radiator, oil cooler and engine bay of debris. To reach the engine bay tilt the cab, and always engage the cab support first.

cab.name: Cab (ROPS/FOPS)
cab.desc: Enclosed cab. Daily: seat bar and seat belt interlocks, lights, travel alarm and wiper. Cab air filter every 1000 h: 84376814 (84376815 is the charcoal version). These numbers come from the L225/L230 diagram, which does not name the C227, so check them against the fitted filter. The cab tilts for engine access: engage the cab support before working under it.

door.name: Front door, glass and wiper
door.desc: Open job MCH-2: the wiper blade has been missing since 18 Aug 2026. Blade 47405956: aftermarket listings name the C227, but the number has not been checked against a CNH parts book. Check the wiper works as part of the daily checks.

lights.name: Work lights and beacons
lights.desc: Front work lights and amber beacons on the cab roof. Check lights and the travel alarm daily.

exhaust.name: Exhaust stack
exhaust.desc: Exhaust outlet for the FPT F5H FL463A 3.4 L Tier 4B engine. Keep the engine bay clear of debris (daily clean-out with the cab tilted and the support engaged).

armL.name: Loader arm, left
armL.desc: Grease all loader arm, link, cylinder and coupler pivots with moly grease GR-75 (molybdenum disulfide): daily or every 10 h in dirty work (best practice), 50 h at the latest (secondary source). Greasing is overdue (open item): taskTracker template 30810 has no interval, so it never comes due.

armR.name: Loader arm, right (far side)
armR.desc: Grease all loader arm, link, cylinder and coupler pivots with moly grease GR-75 (molybdenum disulfide): daily or every 10 h in dirty work (best practice), 50 h at the latest (secondary source). Greasing is overdue (open item): taskTracker template 30810 has no interval, so it never comes due.

liftcyl.name: Lift cylinder, left
liftcyl.desc: Grease both cylinder pins with the loader pivots (moly grease GR-75; daily or every 10 h in dirty work, 50 h at the latest). Look for hydraulic leaks daily.

tiltL.name: Tilt cylinder, left
tiltL.desc: Tilts the coupler and bucket. Grease both pins with the loader pivots (moly grease GR-75; daily or every 10 h in dirty work, 50 h at the latest). Look for leaks daily.

aux.name: Auxiliary hydraulic couplers and hoses
aux.desc: Look for hydraulic leaks at the couplers and hoses daily. An earlier hydraulic leak was reported on the RH side near the track: re-check the hoses and fittings at the RH drive motor at the next service.

bucket.name: Bucket and coupler
bucket.desc: Grease the bucket and coupler pivots with the loader arm points (moly grease GR-75; daily or every 10 h in dirty work).

frame.name: Main frame
frame.desc: Main frame between the tracks. Look under the machine for hydraulic leaks daily, especially on the RH side near the track where a leak was reported earlier.

track.name: Rubber track, left
track.desc: Daily: track tension, cuts, and debris packed in the sprockets, idlers and rollers. Check and adjust the tension every 50 h. The tracks have no grease points apart from the tensioner. The track, sprocket, roller and idler numbers in Notion (87480418, 87480410, 87480400, 87480395) were not verified: measure the track and quote by PIN NJM448024.

underc.name: Track frame, rollers and idlers
underc.desc: Clean out packed debris daily and check the rollers and idlers for leaks and wear. The only grease point is the track tensioner. Roller and idler numbers must be quoted by PIN (the Notion numbers were not verified).

engine.name: Engine: FPT F5H FL463A 3.4 L turbo diesel
engine.desc: FPT F5H FL463A (F5HFL463A*F001) 3.4 L 4-cylinder turbo diesel, 74 hp gross / 68 hp net, Tier 4B (Notion's 'ISM N844' is wrong). Oil 8.5 L with filter, API CJ-4: NH Ambra Unitek Mastergold 10W-40 or 0W-40, or 15W-40 CJ-4 above -20 C. Change the oil and filter every 250 h; the service manual allows up to 600 h (halve it on B5-B20 biodiesel), so 250 h is conservative. Check the alternator/fan belt and battery every 100 h. taskTracker template 32657 (250 h) has no tasks or parts yet.

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Spin-on filter, change with the oil every 250 h. 47535939 supersedes the older number in CNH kit 73341672; the catalogue notes it is now superseded by NH 87679598. Aftermarket equivalent listed: Wix WL10061 / SL10061. 48138563 is an aftermarket listing for the F5HFL463D engine: check it suits this F5HFL463A before using it.

fuel.name: Fuel tank, filters and water separator
fuel.desc: Tank 75.5 L, ultra-low-sulphur diesel; biodiesel max B20 to ASTM D6751. Drain the fuel/water separator daily. In-line filter 47572791 every 250 h. Main spin-on filter and separator element every 500 h. Spin-on number conflict: CNH kit 73341672 (fits C227) contains 84299977, an aftermarket C227 Tier 4B kit lists 84534796 and the C232 Tier 4B kit lists 5802726986. Separator element: three numbers from aftermarket sources (87803444, 84527831, 84559022). Confirm both against PIN NJM448024 before ordering. Notion's 84565867 / 84557099 are wrong.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Check the restriction indicator daily. Replace the primary 84217229 and the secondary (safety) 87682999 every 500 h. 87682993 is a same-size primary (91 x 164.5 x 347 mm). Aftermarket: primary Ryco HDA5949 (Ryco cross-references it) or Wesfil WA5019 (check fit); secondary Ryco HDA5950 (cross-referenced) or Wesfil WA1154 (check fit). Notion's 87517154 / 87517153 are wrong.

hydraulics.name: Hydraulic tank and filter
hydraulics.desc: System 38.1 L (reservoir 15.0 L; the manual table is hard to read and a secondary source also gives 38 L). NH Ambra Hydrosystem 46 HV (factory fill); Tutela Auto Supreme 10W-30 for continuous work over 38 C. Check the sight glass daily. Filter 47710533 every 500 h (47456328 is the older number, 47833564 an aftermarket listing). Change the oil every 1000 h: at about 995 h this is due now, and there is no 500, 1000 or 2000 h template in taskTracker yet. Notion's case drain filter 84233069 is not in the CNH C227 kit and may not exist on this machine.

cooling.name: Radiator, oil cooler and coolant
cooling.desc: NH Ambra Actifull OT Extended Life Coolant, about 19 L (the manual table is hard to read; a secondary source says 17.0 L, so fill to the mark). Drain, flush and refill every 2000 h. Clean the radiator and oil cooler daily: tilt the cab with the support engaged.

battery.name: Battery, alternator and fan belt
battery.desc: Check the battery and the alternator/fan belt every 100 h. Notion's drive belt 87542364, alternator 84208447 and starter 84208449 were not found in any CNH source: get numbers by PIN.

drive.name: Track drive motors and pump
drive.desc: Final drives: check the oil level each side every 100 h and change it every 500 h, SAE 80W-90 EP gear lube to the level plug (capacity not legible in the manual). An earlier leak was reported on the RH side near the track: check the hoses and fittings at the RH drive motor. Notion's motor (87588897/8) and pump (84565752) numbers were not found in any CNH source.

controls.name: Joysticks, seat bar and interlocks
controls.desc: Daily: seat bar and seat belt interlocks. Starting fault 'JOYNU' means joystick not in neutral: check the joysticks are centred and the neutral sensors and wiring are OK, and call CNH service if it persists.

filterkit.name: CNH filter kit 73341672 and service schedule
filterkit.desc: Kit 'F5C filters': engine oil, two fuel, two air and the hydraulic filter; lists C227, C232, C238, L223, L225, L230. 250 h: engine oil and filter, in-line fuel filter. 500 h: also both air filters, main fuel filter and separator, hydraulic filter, final drive oil. 1000 h: hydraulic oil and cab air filter. 2000 h: coolant. The operator's manual chart was not online: these intervals come from a secondary source, so check them against the chart in the cab.

sprocket.name: Drive sprocket and final drive
sprocket.desc: Planetary final drive behind the rear sprocket. Check the oil level every 100 h; change every 500 h with SAE 80W-90 EP gear lube, filled to the level plug. Keep the sprocket teeth clear of packed debris.

84376815.name: Cab air filter, charcoal
84376815.note: Charcoal version of 84376814, from the L225/L230 diagram; C227 fit not confirmed.

87679598.name: Engine oil filter (superseding number)
87679598.note: Catalogue note: 47535939 is superseded by NH 87679598.

48138563.name: Engine oil filter (aftermarket listing)
48138563.note: Listed for the F5HFL463D engine. This machine has the F5HFL463A: check before ordering.

84534796.name: Main fuel filter (alternative)
84534796.note: Listed in an aftermarket C227 Tier 4B kit. CNH kit 73341672 has 84299977: confirm by PIN NJM448024.

5802726986.name: Main fuel filter (alternative)
5802726986.note: Listed in the C232 Tier 4B kit. Confirm by PIN NJM448024.

87803444.name: Fuel/water separator element (unconfirmed)
87803444.note: One of three numbers from aftermarket sources. Confirm by PIN.

84527831.name: Fuel/water separator element (unconfirmed)
84527831.note: One of three numbers from aftermarket sources. Confirm by PIN.

84559022.name: Fuel/water separator element (unconfirmed)
84559022.note: One of three numbers from aftermarket sources. Confirm by PIN.

87682993.name: Air filter, primary (same size)
87682993.note: Same size as 84217229 (91 x 164.5 x 347 mm).
